review.notes: The package predates the 2026-10-12 shape rule (PACKAGE_REVIEW.md, Shape of a roadmap) and fails both of its gates, on which the rule requires needs_changes: Suggested.lean has 6,077 lines (cap 5,000) and 46 data definitions or instances with a sorry body (scripts/check_sorry_data.py). It also develops theory through stand-in carriers (HilbertModel, GLAutomorphicDatum, ModularGeometry, CochainData with its own cohomology, projective_tensor with sorry'd instances). The README is in the atlas catalogue form forbidden by README in TauCetiRoadmap form: AS.k.j headings; Assume/API/Tests/Source/Uses field lists; B and S labels; 83 atlas slugs; no Checks, Examples, Dependencies, Summary, supplier-contract or build sections; process traces such as '(quoted input)' and 'item 88'. The fix is a rewrite of both files, so the reviewer changed nothing in the package; the report lists the exact revision steps. Supplier contract: upstream ArithmeticLocallySymmetricSpaces (TauCetiRoadmap PR #871) now owns automorphic forms, constant terms and cusp forms (ALS.F.6), so the AF.2/AF.3 slugs must point there. ALS takes Franke as the hypothesis FrankeInput(G,K,V) of ALS.5b.4. AS.5.10 and AS.5.12 discharge its clauses (a) and (b), but clause (c), the Kostant-weight eigensystem description for proper associate classes, is stated only for GL_n and must be added or recorded as a gap. All cited roadmaps are lower-tier or upstream, and no duplication with TauCetiRoadmap main 0d144d0 or Tau Ceti a91d3aaf was found.
